prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this one reference image, preserving its whole 16:9 composition and everything except the purple-cloaked commander's head/eyes and very subtle authoritative posture.
The tall thin man in the LEFT foreground (CM, black topknot, pointed long black beard, plum cloak, brown armor) should look DIRECTLY at GU, the short-grey-curled broad older woman in green armor behind the food cart at screen RIGHT. Turn only his head and eyes naturally to his right toward that woman, rather than scanning away to the left or looking toward the camera. His chin is firm and level, proud and stubborn, preserving dignity after being exposed; he will lift it slightly in the later action, so do not tilt it dramatically upward now. Keep his familiar face and stern brows. His body stays erect and in exactly its existing foreground location. No sneer, smile, shame, shock or comedy mugging.
STRICT invariants: keep the CM's cloak, both arms/hands positions, ONE hand concealed inside the cloak and the other existing visible resting hand unchanged. NO commander spoon visible yet. Keep ALL other people, their faces, expressions, positions, costumes unchanged; GU's gaze already toward him, RC at far right holding documents/tablet. Keep the exact colossal horse, purple crescent, exactly THREE open square windows with exactly THREE single-leaf wooden doors (one leaf to LEFT of each opening), exactly THREE soldiers olive/blue/ochre left-to-right, exactly SIX soldier arms, THREE silver bowls, THREE wooden spoons. Keep the open steaming stainless food cart and its hanging DOWN metal ladle untouched. Keep the fortress, plain green banners, distant soldiers, daylight, shadows, camera angle, focal length, rich cinematic stylized live-action rendering and all textures intact. No new text, no title, no logo. No new objects, no extra door leaf, no altered tableware. This is an extremely localized direction-of-gaze/authority refinement, not a remake. Output one landscape 16:9 image.

notes: 참조와 새 출력 실제 view_image 열람. CM 얼굴이 화면 오른쪽 GU 방향으로 더 분명하게 회전했고 단호한 입·눈썹·곧은 자세 유지. 턱 과장 들림/익살 표정 없음.
CM 한손 망토 안, 반대 기존 손 그대로, 개인 숟가락 아직 없음. 세 창·좌측 단일 문짝3·병사3·팔6·은그릇3·나무숟가락3 유지. GU 국자 내려짐과 RC 원문/태블릿, 수레·김·목마·초승달·깃발 배치 보존.
확인 범위는 정지 이미지. 후속 턱 들기·숟가락 등장·대사·실제 시선 움직임은 미생성/미검증.
